decision.summary: A broad, multi-axis uplift initiates around index 565, peaking in U near 570 (+7 MAD), with coherent positive responses in N and E. The event decays gradually through 575 but no opposing return is observed within the allowed context [530,610]; thus the interval remains uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed inside the context.

intervals.observation: Broad U-dominated uplift beginning ~565, with coherent positive N/E excursions; no sharp return observed within allowed context (530–610). Onset at ~565 shows gradual rise in U (from ~-0.2 to +5+ MAD), sustained interior (U > +4 MAD from 568–574), and decay without reversal—return not observed before 610. N/E show smaller but consistent positive shifts (~+2–3 MAD) during same window. Status: uncertain due to missing return.
